title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A guard that refused too much
summary: Yesterday's guard against scanning a source jar asked for a workspace folder, and two of the three linters it was applied to do not need one.

highlights.title: Linters that work on a lone file again
highlights.description: Only the resource diagnostics compare code against the project index and need a workspace folder. The other two read nothing but the file in front of them, and requiring a folder turned them off the moment a file was opened without one.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Two per file linters went quiet on a file opened on its own, and on an untitled buffer. Two levels of guard now, one per question.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Neither came from a report; both came from rereading a guard written thirty minutes earlier and asking what it refuses that it should not.
